evidence.notes: Observed controller save/getId behavior works against local SObject DML.
Observed list pagination helpers work for local record lists.
Observed constructors and getters/setters are supported.

source.content: public class RuntimeVisualforceController { private ApexPages.StandardController controller; public RuntimeVisualforceController() {} public RuntimeVisualforceController(ApexPages.StandardController controller) { this.controller = controller; } public PageReference save() { return controller.save(); } public List<SelectOption> getOptions() { SelectOption option = new SelectOption('1', 'One', true); option.setLabel('Changed'); return new List<SelectOption>{option}; } }

@isTest private class VisualforceControllerRuntimeTest { @isTest static void controllerAndUiValueRuntime() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'VF'); ApexPages.StandardController std = new ApexPages.StandardController(account); PageReference saved = std.save(); System.assertNotEquals(null, std.getId()); System.assertEquals('/' + std.getId(), saved.getUrl()); System.assertEquals('/apex/mypage', Page.MyPage.getUrl().toLowerCase()); SObject original = std.getRecord(); original.put('Name', 'Changed'); System.assertEquals('Changed', (String)std.getRecord().get('Name')); Account doomed = new Account(Name = 'Delete Me'); insert doomed; Id doomedId = doomed.Id; ApexPages.StandardController deleteController = new ApexPages.StandardController(doomed); PageReference deleted = deleteController.delete(); System.assert(deleted.getUrl().startsWith('/')); SelectOption option = new SelectOption('1', 'One', true); option.setLabel('Changed'); System.assertEquals('1', option.getValue()); System.assertEquals('Changed', option.getLabel()); System.assert(option.getDisabled()); System.assertEquals(true, option.getEscapeItem()); ApexPages.StandardSetController setController = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Set First'), new Account(Name = 'Second')}); System.assertEquals(2, setController.getRecords().size()); System.assertEquals('Set First', (String)setController.getRecords()[0].get('Name')); } }
